items.explanation: Bern Grand Council government affair (Kreditgeschäft RR 2011.RRGR.410, 'Approbation du compte 2010' of the lottery fund). The report prints 'Berne, le 18 février 2010', yet it reports the 2010 accounts and cites the audit report of 4 February 2011, so the printed year is a typo for 2011. The strict gold follows the protocol (the date as printed); both annotators also listed 2011-02-18 as the lenient alternative. OPD's 'submission' (2011-06-06) is the date the government business went to parliament, which follows the executive's report for government affairs, so the ordering check does not apply to this affair type.

items.explanation: Mendrisio municipal preliminary report ('rapporto preliminare del Municipio', Ris.mun. 2345 del 20 dicembre 2016) on a motion the document says was presented on 11 October 2016. OPD files it under a later affair, the municipal message MM 71/2018 (OPD 'Eingereicht' 2018-09-14), which carries the 2016 report as an attachment. The gold is the printed decision date of this document; the ordering check compares it with a different (later) affair's submission date.

result: 0 of 3 are gold errors under the labelling protocol. 300277 and 886123 are genuine: an executive decision on a government business that precedes its submission to parliament, and a 2016 report that OPD files under a 2018 affair. 249052 is labelled as printed, but the printed year is a typo in the source (the report on the 2010 accounts cites a February 2011 audit); the evident date 2011-02-18 is printed nowhere in the document and is already the lenient alternative.
